roads.name: Whiskey Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 13 curves in 3.1 miles.
From 63 to 115 ft, with 169 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
July highs average 82°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 30 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.22 g.

roads.name: Calverton Drive
words: Properly twisty: 19 curves in 2.4 miles, about 8 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 53 to 103 ft, with 130 ft of up and down along the way.
July highs average 82°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 10 mph limit its corners ask for only about 0.03 g, so the limit, not the curves, sets the pace.
